{{Top|leg}}
'''Heat-seeking [[laser mine]]s''' were of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] design used in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A deep-space mine, these weapons were used to defend [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. When deployed, the mines would lock onto intense heat sources, such as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] exhaust nacelles, and destroy them.
